remarks:
Welcome to 103 Sturges Street, a lovingly maintained Northside Jamestown home where inviting living spaces, thoughtful updates, and beautiful landscaping create a warm welcome. Offering three bedrooms and one and a half baths, this charming home blends everyday comfort with lasting appeal. The spacious living room and large formal dining room feature flooring updated in 2022. The eat-in kitchen includes a dishwasher and disposal, while first-floor laundry and a half bath add convenience. A bright, window-lined enclosed front porch offers a cheerful retreat to enjoy your morning coffee, settle in with a favorite book, or simply relax.
Step outside to the 17-by-20-foot composite rear deck with vinyl railing, overlooking an exceptionally landscaped, partially fenced backyard. This beautiful outdoor setting is perfect for enjoying the seasons. The one-and-a-half-car garage received new electric service, replacement wiring on both levels, and a new garage door opener in 2024. The driveway was also redone from the gravel base in 2024.
Additional improvements include a roof approximately seven years old, a newer furnace installed shortly before the current owner purchased the home, vinyl replacement windows throughout, updated electric service, and a vinyl-sided exterior. The sewer line was also replaced from the house to the street, offering added confidence in the care and maintenance this home has received.
Owner-reported monthly utilities average approximately $65 for electric, $60 for National Fuel, and $50 combined for water, sewer, and trash pickup, making the utilities reasonable. With welcoming spaces, and pride of ownership evident throughout, this is truly a home where you can just bring your furnishings and move right in.
